title: NGramStore: Compression, Storage and Exact Lookup for Learned N-Gram Embeddings
description: A compression, storage and exact-lookup backend for frozen learned n-gram embedding tables, with optional DATrie/mark-compact structure and FastText/Engram integrations. Lossless and approximate modes are reported separately. Originated from the 2017 me_fasttext prototype (arXiv:2506.01254).
